limitations: dependencies are a may-over-approximation: a listed field does not mean it affected a given frame
a field being present in an observation does not establish that it was measured rather than defaulted
history state is analyzed by name; warm-up length and eviction are not modeled
condition_selected outputs take values chosen by tests alone; whether the tested field is the quantity itself or a stand-in for another quantity is only hinted by condition_field_named_in_output
